description: Finds or opens the conversation thread for a recruiting candidate (candidate_id, from read the candidate), as opening their record does, so their thread and reminders have an anchor. Nothing is sent. A candidate who is not active and has no thread yet comes back with no conversation unless force is true (a deliberate decision to work them). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: open_candidate_conversation
title: Open a candidate's conversation
